verdict.rationale: Wise's own docs and site directly claim global payments arrive in under 20 seconds, well inside the story's one-minute bar. A delivery-estimate API also lets users check expected arrival times. The claim is qualified as applying to 'most' transfers, and only vendor sources support it. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of transfer speed, documentation of which corridors or currencies achieve sub-minute delivery versus slower ones.
